test_title: PYST 209: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 1st Nov, 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the sequence.

R _ T _ T U _ _ R U _ S _ S T
solution:
Given :- R _ T _ T U _ _ R U _ S _ S T

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) SSTURR → R **S** T - **S** T U - **T U** R - U **R** S - **R** S T

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00844fe5036c75df676f5e1921d37e9e1919a15f15088082b4210428915a11c7.png] 

 
• Here, the last two letter in each set is repeating in the next set as first two letters and third letter is next alphabet of previous letter in the particular set.

2) SRTURU → R **S** T - **R** T U - **T U** R - U **R** S - **U** S T

3) STURSR → R **S** T - **T** T U - **U R **R - U **S** S - **R** S T

4) URTSSR → R **U** T - **R** T U - **T S** R - U **S** S - **R** S T

Hence, the correct answer is **"SSTURR".**
